name: mf_fno_residfid
description: Transfer-learning MF-FNO (pretrain LF -> fine-tune HF; Lyu 2023) with FiLM-on-X conditioning and a PDE-residual self-supervised auxiliary loss: loss = MSE + lambda*mean(||Delta u||^2), where Delta u is a finite-difference interior-Laplacian smoothness residual (torch conv stencil) on the de-normalized prediction. This is a deliberately weak, dataset-agnostic PHYSICAL PRIOR and an explicit PLACEHOLDER for the true governing PDE operator R(u). Applied to HF (and optionally LF via --resid_on_lf). extra reports the loss weight and final residual magnitude. Only the training loss differs from the frozen FiLM winner.
